# Pinned dependency set for Radicale (the [bcrypt] extra included), so two
# deploys of the same catalog serial install the same code.
#
# This file is COMMITTED rather than generated by scripts/download.sh: a
# generated one is invisible to `hop3-catalog validate`, which scans the
# blueprint's files, so an unpinned set shipped and only failed later on the
# node — which is exactly what happened here.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   echo 'radicale[bcrypt]==<version>' > requirements.in
#   uv pip compile --python-version 3.12 requirements.in -o requirements.txt
